name: University of California, Berkeley
character: The low-lying central campus features Beaux-Arts Classical and Victorian Second-Empire buildings, two branches of Strawberry Creek, and wooded areas including the Eucalyptus Grove.

landmarks.name: Sather Tower
landmarks.quote: and the Sather Tower (nicknamed "the Campanile" after its architectural inspiration, St Mark's Campanile in Venice)
landmarks.look: Tall Beaux-Arts Classical clock tower inspired by St Mark's Campanile.

landmarks.name: Sather Gate
landmarks.quote: Sather Gate, and the Sather Tower

landmarks.name: Doe Memorial Library
landmarks.quote: Doe Memorial Library, California Hall, Wheeler Hall

landmarks.name: California Memorial Stadium
landmarks.quote: passes beneath California Memorial Stadium before appearing again in Faculty Glade.

landmarks.name: South Hall
landmarks.quote: Built in 1873 in a Victorian Second-Empire-style, South Hall, designed by David Farquharson, is the oldest university building in California.

landmarks.name: Hearst Greek Theatre
landmarks.quote: and include Hearst Greek Theatre, Hearst Memorial Mining Building

landmarks.name: University of California Botanical Garden
landmarks.quote: The campus is also home to the University of California Botanical Garden, with more than 12,000 individual species.
landmarks.look: Botanical garden with diverse plant species.

landmarks.name: University of California Museum of Paleontology
landmarks.name_en: University of California Museum of Paleontology
landmarks.quote: The campus is home to several museums including the University of California Museum of Paleontology
landmarks.look: Museum with dinosaur fossils and a Tyrannosaurus Rex cast.
